balance.label: Cash & equivalents (some periods incl. restricted cash)

warnings: debt: 3 cell(s) where two debt lines are the same filed fact (same value, date and filing under two tags) are counted once — e.g. 2016-09-30 long_term_debt (LongTermDebt) = current_lt_debt (LongTermDebtCurrent) = 3,039,000; the current_lt_debt cell is blank

other non-operating: NonoperatingIncomeExpense is the filer's whole non-operating section (interest included) for some periods; shown as that total + interest expense − interest income (plain arithmetic, reconciles to pretax income) for 24 period(s)

quarters not derived (the year-to-date fact's tag has no shorter leg in the same tag: the 10-Qs carried the figure in another caption; flagged basis_break_quarterly): other_opex 2019-12-31, interest_expense 2019-12-31, interest_expense 2020-12-31, da 2014-06-30, deferred_taxes 2017-12-31, deferred_taxes 2019-12-31, deferred_taxes 2020-12-31, deferred_taxes 2021-12-31, deferred_taxes 2022-12-31, deferred_taxes 2023-12-31, deferred_taxes 2024-12-31, deferred_taxes 2025-12-31...
capex: no capital-expenditure figure is filed for 2 period(s) with operating cash flow (2015-03-31..2015-06-30); free cash flow and owner's earnings are blank there (capex is never read as zero)

income statement: the operating lines shown for FY ending 2025-12-31 explain 594,175,000 of the 707,042,000 between revenue and operating income — the filer tags its other operating lines with custom elements that EDGAR companyfacts does not carry

restricted cash: in 3 period(s), 2018-03-31..2018-09-30 the cash line is the filed cash + restricted cash total (CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalents, the cash-flow statement's total, read where the annual report filed no CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue for the date); in 3 period(s), 2018-03-31..2018-09-30 no figure separates the restricted part, so where those metrics are computed they still count restricted cash as cash (net cash overstated, net debt understated by the restricted amount; flagged incl_restricted_* and labelled 'some periods incl. restricted cash' on the metric; growth across a change between the two bases is blank)

growth across filing generations: 2 annual growth cell(s) are blank because the year and the year before come from different filings that disagree (one restated by a later filing — discontinued operations, an accounting change, a recast — the other as originally filed; or a capex caption change): change_inventory (2023-12-31); change_receivables (2023-12-31)
